name: Swift Concurrency, Combine & Reactive Programming
description: Modern and traditional asynchronous programming on iOS. Covers Grand Central Dispatch (GCD), OperationQueue, Swift Modern Concurrency (async/await, Tasks, TaskGroups), Actors and @MainActor thread safety, AsyncSequence / AsyncStream, Combine framework (Publishers, Subscribers, Operators), Thread Sanitizer (TSan) race detection, and RxSwift migration.

subskills.name: Grand Central Dispatch (GCD) & Dispatch Queues
subskills.description: Managing concurrency using Grand Central Dispatch (GCD) — DispatchQueue (Main, Global QoS: userInteractive, userInitiated, utility, background, custom serial and concurrent queues), async vs sync execution, DispatchGroup, and DispatchWorkItem.

subskills.name: Operation & OperationQueue Architecture
subskills.description: Managing complex, cancellable, dependent background jobs with Operation and OperationQueue — BlockOperation, custom Operation subclasses (isExecuting, isFinished, isCancelled KVO states), setting dependencies (addDependency), and maxConcurrentOperationCount.

subskills.name: Swift Modern Concurrency: async/await & Tasks
subskills.description: Writing asynchronous code with modern Swift concurrency — async/await, Task, Task.sleep, Task.detached, structured concurrency with async let and withTaskGroup, cooperative cancellation checking (Task.isCancelled, try Task.checkCancellation()).

subskills.name: Actors, @MainActor & Data Race Elimination
subskills.description: Eliminating data races at compile time with Swift Actors — actor declaration, actor isolation rules, nonisolated keyword, cross-actor message passing, @MainActor for UI thread confinement, and Global Actors.

subskills.name: AsyncSequence, AsyncStream & Bridging Delegates
subskills.description: Consuming asynchronous streams of values using AsyncSequence protocol — for await in loops, creating custom AsyncStream and AsyncThrowingStream (continuation yield, onTermination), and bridging legacy callback/delegate APIs into async streams.

subskills.name: Combine Framework: Publishers & Subscribers
subskills.description: Reactive programming with Apple's Combine framework — AnyPublisher, PassthroughSubject, CurrentValueSubject, subscriber subscriptions (.sink, .assign(to:on:)), managing AnyCancellable memory lifecycle with Set<AnyCancellable> (store(in:)).

subskills.name: Advanced Combine Operators & Stream Composition
subskills.description: Composing complex asynchronous pipelines using Combine operators: flatMap, combineLatest, zip, merge, debounce, throttle, removeDuplicates, error recovery with catch and retry, and switching execution with receive(on:) and subscribe(on:).

subskills.name: Thread Sanitizer (TSan) & Lock Synchronization
subskills.description: Detecting and resolving multithreaded data races in production iOS applications — utilizing Xcode Thread Sanitizer (TSan), implementing high-performance low-level locks with os_unfair_lock, and ensuring thread-safe shared mutable state.

subskills.name: RxSwift / RxCocoa & Modern Concurrency Migration
subskills.description: Working with RxSwift and RxCocoa in enterprise applications — Observable, Single, Completable, DisposeBag, Schedulers, Traits (Driver, Signal), and executing structured migration plans from RxSwift to native Combine and async/await.
